pk.context: 801 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: white to off-white, hard gelatin capsule

tell: Food cuts this pyridone's peak concentration by about 49%, and its mechanism in pulmonary fibrosis is unestablished.

clues.text: The absolute bioavailability has not been determined, and food lowers peak concentration by about 49%. About 58% is bound to plasma proteins, and about 80% of the dose is excreted in urine as a metabolite.
Molecular weight 185.22. A white to pale yellow, non-hygroscopic powder.
Approved under an NDA in 267 mg capsules and in 267 mg and 801 mg tablets; the 801 mg dose is three capsules.
No boxed warning and no contraindications. Rash and nausea are the adverse reactions most often leading to discontinuation.
Its mechanism of action in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis has not been established.
The generic name begins with P and has eleven letters.
